newsitem.title: USA: Federal Signal Q3 net about even with yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Federal Signal Q3 net about even with yr ago.

text.p: Federal Signal Corp said on Thursday that it expects its second quarter and third quarter earnings to approximate those it had reported a year ago.
Second quarter earnings in 1996 totaled $16.0 million, or $0.35 a share, on revenues of $232.3 million.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $15.9 million, $0.35 a share, on revenues of $230.3 million.
Federal Signal said short-term order deferrals are continuing longer than it had anticipated, but bidding activity remains strong.
Federal Signal, a maker of safety and signalling products and emergency and environmental vehicles, said it expects improved results in the fourth quarter and in 1998.
